patch_description: Reorganizes the search into a staged pipeline: repair and diversify seed networks, maintain a bounded score-ranked frontier, then spend LP calls in small batches on one selected parent at a time. Neighborhood generation is split into focused switches, sampled rotations, and multi-switch perturbations, with per-parent stall counts and operator success rates guiding the effort. Surrogate energy screens proposals before LP evaluation, while bottleneck-touching moves and frontier diversity keep the search from relying on the surrogate alone.
